image_description: A large, dark wood built-in bookcase spanning a wall in a room. The unit features multiple vertical sections with adjustable shelves filled with books, CDs, and decorative items. There are glass-fronted cabinets on the right side and open shelving on the left and center. A potted plant sits on top of the central section. To the left, a black chair and a framed picture are visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The structure is clearly a tall, rectangular piece of furniture that extends significantly higher than its individual section widths, fitting the description.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The bookcase has a clear outer frame and distinct horizontal shelves dividing the space vertically.

artifact_observations.reasoning: Upon close inspection, the text on many book spines is illegible or appears as nonsensical patterns rather than real titles, a common AI artifact in detailed text rendering.
The plant leaves have a slightly smudged, painterly texture lacking the crisp detail of real foliage, blending slightly into the background wall.

artifact_observations.location: Vertical lines of the bookcase frame
artifact_observations.reasoning: Slight warping in the vertical stiles of the bookcase; they do not remain perfectly parallel, suggesting minor geometric instability typical of generative models.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a bookcase and not a similar storage unit like a cabinet or shelving rack.
To verify the structural integrity of the shelves and ensure books are properly grounded on them without floating or clipping.
To check for boundary bleeding between the glass reflections and the interior shelves, ensuring distinct physical layers.
To rigorously evaluate the legibility and coherence of text on book spines, which was flagged as a potential artifact.

focus_areas: Geometric alignment of vertical and horizontal lines
Boundary sharpness between glass doors and interior contents
Texture consistency of the wood finish
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'text_gibberish' artifact on the book spines. While the overall structure is sound, AI often fails at rendering coherent small text. Verify if the geometric depth auditor finds any books floating off shelves. Check if the topology auditor detects any fusion between the glass door reflections and the books behind them.
